question: Who received the Lifetime Achievement Award at the Bengaluru International Film Festival, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shabana Azmi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Renowned veteran actress **Shabana Azmi** was honored with the prestigious **Lifetime Achievement Award** at the **16th Bengaluru International Film Festival (BIFFes)** in **2025**.
 
• The award was presented to her in recognition of her monumental contribution to **Indian cinema** over a career spanning more than **50 years**.
 
• The **16th edition** of the festival was scheduled from **February 27 to March 6, 2025**, in **Bengaluru**, the capital of **Karnataka**.
 
• The announcement was made by the **Karnataka Chalanachitra Academy**, which organizes the event under the aegis of the **Government of Karnataka**.
 
• **Shabana Azmi** is celebrated for her versatility and her role in the **Parallel Cinema** movement in India, which brought realistic and socially relevant themes to the forefront.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Career Highlights of Shabana Azmi:**
 
 
• She made her acting debut in **1974** with the film **Ankur**, directed by **Shyam Benegal**, which earned her the first of several **National Film Awards**.
 
• She holds the record for the most wins in the **National Film Award for Best Actress** category, having won the title **five times** for films like **Arth**, **Khandhar**, and **Paar**.
 
• The **Government of India** honored her with the **Padma Shri** in **1988** and the **Padma Bhushan** in **2012** for her excellence in the arts.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru International Film Festival (BIFFes):**
 
 
• It is a premier film festival in India that showcases world cinema to the local audience and provides a platform for **Asian** and **Indian filmmakers**.
 
• The festival includes various competition sections, such as the **Chitrapura Asian Cinema Competition** and the **Indian Cinema Competition**.
 
• The **2025** edition focused on diverse storytelling, featuring over **200 films** from across the globe.
 
 
 
• **Social Contributions:**
 
 
• Beyond her cinematic achievements, **Shabana Azmi** is a dedicated **social activist**, focusing on **child survival**, fighting **AIDS**, and advocating for the rights of **slum dwellers** and **women**.
 
• She has also served as a nominated member of the **Rajya Sabha**, the upper house of the **Parliament of India**, from **1997 to 2003**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Lifetime Achievement Award** at **BIFFes** is one of the highest honors bestowed by the state of **Karnataka** in the field of cinema.
 
• Previous recipients of such prestigious honors at film festivals include legends like **Adoor Gopalakrishnan** and **Amitabh Bachchan**, highlighting the caliber of the award.
 
• The festival also plays a crucial role in promoting the **Kannada film industry** (Sandalwood) by hosting a dedicated **Kannada Cinema Competition** section.
 
• In **2025**, the festival venue spread across multiple screens at **Orion Mall** and other cultural hubs in **Bengaluru** to ensure wide public accessibility.
